dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, did you see Ploy's post last night?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈsiː ˈplɔɪz ˈpoʊst ˈlæst ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! She announced that she was starting a new job.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ʃiː əˈnaʊnst ðæt ʃiː wʌz ˈstɑːrtɪŋ ə ˈnuː ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? She didn't mention it in class today.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ʃiː ˈdɪdənt ˈmɛnʃən ɪt ɪn ˈklæs təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In the caption, she explained that she had found a part-time job at a café.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ðə ˈkæpʃən, ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnd ðæt ʃiː hæd ˈfaʊnd ə ⟨part-time⟩ ˈdʒɑːb ət ə kæˈfeɪ

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good for her! And did you see Pete's new post? He tagged me in it.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd fər ˈhɜːr! ənd dɪd juː ˈsiː ˈpiːts ˈnuː ˈpoʊst? hiː ˈtæɡd miː ɪn ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He claimed that he had met a famous actor at the mall.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈkleɪmd ðæt hiː hæd ˈmɛt ə ˈfeɪməs ˈæktər ət ðə ˈmɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But there was no photo of the actor. Only of himself!
dialogue.reading: bʌt ðɛr wʌz ˈnoʊ ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ði ˈæktər. ˈoʊnli əv hɪmˈsɛlf!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And he used ten hashtags. Then Mr. Brown complained that our class chat was too noisy.
dialogue.reading: ənd hiː ˈjuːzd ˈtɛn ˈhæʃtæɡz. ˈðɛn ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn kəmˈpleɪnd ðæt aʊr ˈklæs ˈtʃæt wʌz ˈtuː ˈnɔɪzi.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. He explained that he got fifty messages every night!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. hiː ɪkˈspleɪnd ðæt hiː ˈɡɑːt ˈfɪfti ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, and the big news: our favorite singer revealed that she was getting married!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ənd ðə ˈbɪɡ ˈnuːz: aʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈsɪŋər rɪˈviːld ðæt ʃiː wʌz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmærid!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What? I have to see that post right now!
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt? aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈsiː ˈðæt ˈpoʊst ˈraɪt ˈnaʊ!
